title: Career Work Preferences
description: A dashboard-native questionnaire for recording practical work preferences and career priorities.

source.name: Cleaning Dashboard Job Hunt
source.attribution: Cleaning Dashboard Career Work Preferences, version 1.0.0.
requiredNotices: Results describe stated preferences only and are not psychometric, clinical, or career recommendations.

items.text: I prefer workdays with long, uninterrupted blocks for one demanding task.
I am comfortable being interrupted frequently while I work.
I enjoy switching between several unrelated tasks during the day.
I prefer a workload that is predictable from week to week.
I prefer deciding for myself how to organize and complete my work.
I prefer roles with clear procedures and explicit expectations.
I want technical problem solving to be a major part of my job.
I enjoy coordinating tasks, schedules, or dependencies across people.
I want regular interaction with external clients to be part of my work.
I am comfortable spending a substantial part of my day on administrative tasks.
I want creating new ideas or designs to be a regular part of my work.
I would like a job that involves regular physical activity.
I prefer completing most tasks independently.
I prefer collaborating closely with a small, consistent team.
I am comfortable with several scheduled meetings on a typical workday.
I want frequent direct contact with customers or service users.
I want responsibility for leading and developing other employees.
I prefer working remotely most or all of the time.
I prefer a regular mix of remote and on-site work.
I prefer working at an employer or client site most or all of the time.
I am willing to work rotating or non-standard shifts.
I am willing to work evenings or weekends regularly.
I would like work that requires regular travel.
Maximizing income is a high priority in my next role.
Long-term job stability is a high priority for me.
A clear path to greater responsibility is a high priority for me.
Frequent opportunities to learn new skills are a high priority for me.
Finding the work meaningful or intrinsically interesting is a high priority for me.
A low-chaos, manageable-stress environment is a high priority for me.
I want the option to work from different geographic locations.
I am willing to relocate for the right role.

interpretationLimits: This questionnaire records current stated preferences and is not a validated psychometric instrument.
Scores are not job recommendations and must not be treated as hard constraints.
A missing profile preference remains unknown; completing this assessment does not silently write profile facts.
